name: oscilla
description: OSCILLA - Interactive Sound & Frequency Lab. Builds into one static dist/index.html.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run version:check && npm run build:check && npm run verify-dist && majordomus doctor
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser/app.cjs && node tests/browser/layout.cjs && node tests/browser/qa-regressions.cjs
scripts.test:measure: node tests/browser/v3-measure.cjs && node tests/browser/analysis-worker.cjs && node tests/browser/v3-ui.cjs
scripts.test:studio: node tests/browser/v31-studio-graph.cjs && node tests/browser/v31-studio-timeline.cjs && node tests/browser/v31-studio-audio.cjs && node tests/browser/v31-studio-transport.cjs && node tests/browser/v31-studio-offline.cjs && node tests/browser/v31-studio-workflows.cjs && node tests/browser/v31-studio-links.cjs && node tests/browser/v31-studio-runtime.cjs
scripts.test:visual: node scripts/visual-gate.mjs dist && node scripts/visual-measure.mjs dist && node scripts/visual-studio.mjs dist
scripts.test:release: npm run test:engine && npm run test:dsp && npm run test:labs && npm run test:sequencer && npm run test:measure && npm run test:studio && npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual
scripts.release-gate: npm run verify && npm run test:release
